description: A warm, friendly woman in her thirties or forties with a clear, natural, mid-pitched voice, a native Mandarin Chinese speaker with a standard Putonghua accent. She says a short prayer aloud the way people say it together in church every day: fluent and flowing, at a normal conversational speed, warm and sincere, without dragging and without dramatic pauses.
ref_text: 愿光荣归于父，及子，及圣神，起初如何，今日亦然，直到永远。阿们。
